teaser: A half-read paperback waits, face-down, on the armrest of a chair you left ten minutes ago to go talk to strangers. That is life path 7 and ESFP in one scene: the 7 wants the room to go quiet and the page to finish; the ESFP has already found three people worth talking to and forgotten the book exists. This life path carries a pull toward solitude and truth that argues, politely, with everything ESFP is built for. The disagreement shows up small: two different plans for the same evening, both of them yours.
